name: T2V-CompBench
intro: T2V-CompBench用1400条经人工核验的提示评测文本到视频组合生成，覆盖一致属性、动态属性、空间关系、运动绑定、动作绑定、物体交互和生成计数七类，并为每类选择经人工相关性验证的MLLM、检测或跟踪指标。
org: The University of Hong Kong, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Huawei Noah's Ark Lab
build_method: VidProM语料分析、WordNet概念筛选、GPT-4生成与解析、人工核验、七类均衡
metric: Grid-LLaVA、D-LLaVA、Grounding DINO、SAM+Depth Anything、DOT跟踪及人工相关性
eval_feature: 七类组合视频生成, 类别专用自动指标, 人工相关性验证
build_method_en: VidProM corpus analysis, WordNet concept filtering, GPT-4 generation and parsing, human verification, and seven-category balancing
eval_feature_en: Seven compositional video categories, category-specific automatic metrics, human correlation validation
intro_en: T2V-CompBench uses 1,400 human-verified prompts to evaluate compositional text-to-video generation across consistent attributes, dynamic attributes, spatial relations, motion binding, action binding, object interactions, and generative numeracy. Each category uses MLLM-, detection-, or tracking-based metrics selected through human-correlation validation.
scale_en: 1,400 prompts (200 in each of seven categories)
metric_en: Grid-LLaVA, D-LLaVA, Grounding DINO, SAM + Depth Anything, DOT tracking, and human correlation

drawio_review_note: Aligned with T2V-CompBench arXiv:2407.14505v2 Sections 3-5 and Appendix; official KaiyueSun98/T2V-CompBench repository and t2v-compbench-2025 project page. T2V-CompBench contains 1,400 prompts, with 200 prompts in each of seven categories: consistent attribute binding, dynamic attribute binding, spatial relationships, motion binding, action binding, object interactions, and generative numeracy. The authors analyze 1.67 million unique VidProM prompts, organize concepts with WordNet metaclasses, retain thing rather than stuff objects, and collect 260 nouns, 200 active verbs, and 80 attributes. GPT-4 generates free-form prompts and parsed metadata; every prompt includes an active verb, humans verify and filter the outputs, and challenging uncommon concepts make up 20 percent of relevant categories. Evaluation samples six frames for MLLM metrics, sixteen for detection, and videos at eight frames per second for tracking. Grid-LLaVA scores consistent attributes, actions, and interactions from six-frame grids with chain-of-thought and disentangled questions. D-LLaVA checks initial and final frames for dynamic attributes. Grounding DINO plus geometric rules scores spatial and numeric composition, with SAM and Depth Anything supporting 3D relations. DOT tracks foreground and background motion. Human validation covers 651 videos with three MTurk raters and uses Kendall and Spearman correlations to select the category-specific automatic metrics.
